Found slowly plodding through the flower-fi elds of Valedayn, rutort are a common sight, churning up the soil and chewing the thick 
tubers and vegetables in the rich earth. Often roaming among the herds of similarly sized bloomux, they are known for their docile 
temperament and relaxed grazing, relying on their thick chitin to defend against all but the most dangerous of predators. While 
generally peaceful, when the young pupa that crawl alongside them are threatened, the dozens-strong herd will respond in an earth 
shattering stampede. Th eir simple minds leading them to rampage for hours on end until nearly exhausted and collapsing in a heap of 
churned earth and the crushed corpses of predators.
Class - Insecta • Genus Derived Evolution - Pachnoda • Niche - Specialist Grazing Herbivore

Encountering As a rather slow and docile creature, approaching 
the rutort is quite easy with calm and careful movement. Like 
many herd animals with poor sight, any loud noises or displays 
of aggression will startle them into action. Th e adult females, 
larger in comparison to their male counterparts, will lead the 
stampede in a furious goring rampage.
